title: Assistant Manager | Industrial Relations & Factory HR
description:
We are looking for an experienced HR & Industrial Relations (IR) professional to manage factory HR operations with a strong focus on Industrial Relations, Labour Law Compliance, Factory Compliance, and Statutory Requirements . The role requires hands-on experience in dealing with factory workforce, maintaining statutory records, ensuring legal compliance, and partnering with plant leadership to create a disciplined and compliant work environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Industrial Relations (IR) Manage day-to-day Industrial Relations activities and maintain a healthy work environment within the plant. Build strong relationships with workmen, supervisors, and plant leadership. Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, domestic enquiries, and conflict resolution. Support negotiations and interactions with employee representatives/unions, wherever applicable. 
 Statutory & Labour Law Compliance Ensure compliance with all applicable labour legislations including: Factories Act Industrial Disputes Act Shops & Establishment Act (where applicable) Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act Minimum Wages Act Payment of Wages Act Payment of Bonus Act Payment of Gratuity Act Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) Employees' State Insurance (ESIC) Labour Welfare Fund and other applicable statutes. Coordinate statutory inspections and ensure timely closure of observations. Liaise with government authorities including Factory Inspector, Labour Department, PF, ESIC, and other statutory bodies. 
 Factory HR Operations Manage employee lifecycle activities including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, and separation. Maintain employee records, HR documentation, and statutory registers as per legal requirements. Ensure timely submission of statutory returns and maintenance of mandatory employment registers. Support attendance management, leave administration, and payroll inputs. Coordinate contractor compliance, labour licences, and statutory documentation. 
 HR Operations Support recruitment for plant and shop-floor positions. Assist in performance management, employee engagement, and welfare initiatives. Drive implementation of HR policies, SOPs, and disciplinary processes. Prepare HR MIS, compliance reports, and manpower reports for management. 
 Desired Candidate Profile 410 years of experience in Factory HR, Industrial Relations, and Labour Law Compliance . Strong knowledge of Factories Act, Industrial Relations, Labour Laws, Contract Labour Compliance, PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Bonus, and Wage-related legislations . Hands-on experience in maintaining statutory registers, labour records, and compliance documentation. Experience in handling labour inspections, statutory audits, and interactions with government authorities. Good understanding of contractor workforce management and statutory compliance. Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills. Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS systems. 
 Preferred Background Candidates from manufacturing, steel, engineering, metals, chemicals, cement, mining, automotive, or other industrial manufacturing plants will be preferred. 
 Key Competencies Industrial Relations Labour Law Compliance Factory Compliance Statutory Audits & Inspections PF, ESIC & Gratuity Administration Contract Labour Management Employee Relations Disciplinary & Grievance Handling HR Operations Payroll Coordination HR Documentation & Compliance 
 This role is ideal for a hands-on Factory HR professional who enjoys working on the shop floor, has a strong command of labour legislation and industrial relations, and can ensure a legally compliant, disciplined, and productive manufacturing environment.
